records.jp: ……でね、すごくかっこよくて、<CR>きらきらしてるように見えるんだ！
records.en_original: ...Anyway, it's really cool, and almost like there are sparkles glittering around!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Anyway, it's really cool, and almost like there are sparkles glittering around!
records.en: ...Anyway, it's really cool,<CR>and almost like there are sparkles glittering around!

records.jp: きらきら……か。実際に光を放っているわけでもないのに<CR>そう見えるというのは興味深いな
records.en_original: Sparkles...? Light isn't actually being emitted, so it's quite interesting that it appears that way.
records.en_auxiliary: Sparkles? Light isn't actually being emitted, so it's quite interesting that it appears that way.
records.en: Sparkles...? Light isn't actually being emitted,<CR>so it's quite interesting that it appears that way.

records.jp: 有理、それに凛も。<CR>ずいぶん話が盛り上がってるみたいだね
records.en_original: Hey, guys. It sounds like you're having a lively conversation.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, guys. It sounds like you're having a lively conversation.
records.en: Yuri, Rin.<CR>You seem to be having quite the lively conversation.

records.jp: あ、日菜子。<CR>今ね、恋バナをしてたんだ
records.en_original: Ah, Hinako. We were talking about love just now.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, Hinako. We were talking about love just now.
records.en: Oh, Hinako.<CR>We were talking about love.

records.jp: 恋バナを……えっと、有理と？
records.en_original: Love... Wait, with Yuri?
records.en_auxiliary: Love? Wait, with Yuri?
records.en: About love... Um, with Yuri?

records.jp: ああ。私は恋というものを全く知らないからな。<CR>彼女から教わっていたところだ
records.en_original: Yeah. I don't have the faintest understanding of what love is, so I was having her teach me.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I don't have the faintest understanding of what love is, so I was having her teach me.
records.en: Yes. I know nothing at all about romantic love,<CR>so she was teaching me.

records.jp: なるほど……
records.en_original: That's an idea...
records.en_auxiliary: That's an idea...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: （確かに恋バナと言えば恋バナ……なのかな？）
records.en_original: (Well, it's normal for someone our age to have love on the brain, even if it is analytical...right?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Well, it's normal for someone our age to have love on the brain, even if it is analytical, right?)
records.en: (I suppose it does count as love talk... maybe?)

records.jp: 恋というものは様々な要素が複雑に絡み合って<CR>不可思議な影響を精神にもたらす……
records.en_original: Love is a complex entanglement of various factors and can inexplicably influence the mind...
records.en_auxiliary: Love is a complex entanglement of various factors and can inexplicably influence the mind.
records.en: Love is a complex entanglement of many factors<CR>that produces mysterious effects on the mind...

records.jp: 恋が実際にどのような気持ちを引き起こすのか<CR>尋ねていると、非常に興味深い話が聞けたよ
records.en_original: I was asking about what feelings arise from being in love, and it was all very interesting to hear.
records.en_auxiliary: I was asking about what feelings arise from being in love, and it was all very interesting to hear.
records.en: I asked what feelings being in love actually causes,<CR>and heard a number of fascinating things.

records.jp: だが、私にとってはかけ離れすぎていて<CR>恋そのものの実態はなかなか掴めないな……
records.en_original: However, it's all quite beyond me, so I have a hard time grasping the true nature of love itself...
records.en_auxiliary: However, it's all quite beyond me, so I have a hard time grasping the true nature of love itself.
records.en: But it is so far removed from me<CR>that I still cannot grasp the true nature of love itself...

records.jp: そうだねぇ……恋をしたことがないと、<CR>ちょっとわかりにくいかも
records.en_original: It makes sense... It's hard to understand if you've never been in love before.
records.en_auxiliary: It makes sense... It's hard to understand if you've never been in love before.
records.en: Yeah... It may be difficult to understand<CR>if you have never been in love.

records.jp: せめて恋に近い感情がわかれば、<CR>ある程度見通しがつきそうなのだが……
records.en_original: If I at can least comprehend feelings close to love, I should gain some degree of insight...
records.en_auxiliary: If I can at least comprehend feelings close to love, I should gain some degree of insight.
records.en: If I could at least understand feelings close to love,<CR>I might gain some perspective.

records.jp: 近い感情……かあ。<CR>あえて言うなら、どんな気持ちだろう……
records.en_original: Feelings close to love, huh... Let me think...
records.en_auxiliary: Feelings like love? Let me think...
records.en: Feelings close to love, huh...<CR>Let me think...

records.jp: 恋って、好きな人のことを考えるものだし……<CR>誰かを想う気持ちが一番近いのかもね
records.en_original: Love always has you thinking about someone you like... So maybe thinking about someone is the closest thing?
records.en_auxiliary: Love always has you thinking about someone you like. So maybe thinking about someone special is the closest thing?
records.en: Love means thinking about the person you like,<CR>so perhaps the feeling of caring deeply about someone is closest.

records.jp: それも、考えると胸がどきどきしたり<CR>会いたいって思ったりするような感じだね！
records.en_original: Yeah! When you're thinking about them, your heart beats fast, and you really want to see them!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! When you're thinking about them, your heart beats fast, and you really want to see them!
records.en: And when you think about them, your heart pounds,<CR>and you want to see them!

records.jp: 誰かを想うだけで心拍数が上がる……。<CR>そういった経験は記憶にないな……
records.en_original: Simply thinking about someone raises your heart rate...? I don't recall ever experiencing such a thing...
records.en_auxiliary: Simply thinking about someone raises your heart rate? I don't recall ever experiencing such a thing.
records.en: Simply thinking about someone raises one's heart rate...<CR>I have no memory of such an experience.

records.jp: あはは……まず誰かのことを考えてみるところから始めれば、<CR>ちょっとずつわかってくるんじゃないかな？
records.en_original: Ahaha... Maybe you'll slowly start to understand, if you really start thinking about others?
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... Maybe you'll slowly start to understand if you really start thinking about others?
records.en: Ahaha... Maybe if you start by thinking about someone,<CR>you will gradually begin to understand?

records.jp: なるほど……それで心拍数が上昇するようになれば、<CR>それがすなわち恋ということか
records.en_original: I see... And if my heart rate increases, that means I'm in love with them?
records.en_auxiliary: I see. And if my heart rate increases, that means I'm in love with them?
records.en: I see... And when doing so raises my heart rate,<CR>that would mean it is love.

records.jp: え、と……凛、それで合ってる？
records.en_original: Oh, um... What do you think, Rin?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, um... What do you think, Rin?
records.en: Um... Rin, is that right?

records.jp: えっ？　ええと……
records.en_original: Huh? Uh...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Uh...
records.en: Huh? Uh...

records.jp: どうかな……しようとして出来るものじゃないし、<CR>心拍数とかで判断できるものでもない……かも？
records.en_original: I don't know... It's not something you do on purpose, and it's not just based on heart rate... I think?
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know. It's not something you do on purpose, and it's not just based on heart rate... I think?
records.en: I'm not sure... It isn't something you can force yourself to do,<CR>and I don't think you can judge it from heart rate alone...?

records.jp: ふむ、難しいな……。<CR>だが、恋をするとどうなるのかは大体わかった
records.en_original: Hmm, how inscrutable... However, I now have a general understanding of what happens when one is in love.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, how inscrutable. However, I now have a general understanding of what happens when one is in love.
records.en: Hmm, it is difficult...<CR>But I now have a general understanding of what happens when one falls in love.

records.jp: いずれそういった事象が私の身に起きた時の<CR>参考にさせていただくとしよう
records.en_original: I'll use it as reference, should similar phenomenon ever occur within my body.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll use it as reference, should similar phenomenon ever occur within my body.
records.en: I shall use this as reference<CR>if such a phenomenon ever occurs to me.

records.jp: うん、その時はまた恋バナしようよ！
records.en_original: Yeah, and let's chat about it when you do!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, and let's chat about it when you do!
records.en: Yeah, and when it does, let us talk about love again!

records.jp: （恋バナ、かあ……。有理が恋に興味を持つのは、<CR>ちょっと意外だったかも……？）
records.en_original: (Love talk, huh? I didn't expect Yuri to have any interest in love...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Love talk, huh? I didn't expect Yuri to have any interest in love.)
records.en: (Love talk, huh?<CR>I didn't expect Yuri to have any interest in love...)

records.jp: 恋は盲目っていうし、他のことが目に入らなくなるくらい<CR>夢中になるような気持ちが近いんじゃないかな？
records.en_original: They say love is blind, so maybe being so engrossed that you can't see anything else would be the closest feeling?
records.en_auxiliary: They say love is blind, so maybe being so engrossed that you can't see anything else would be the closest feeling?
records.en: They say love is blind, so perhaps the closest feeling is being so absorbed<CR>that nothing else enters your awareness?

records.jp: あ、確かにそうかも。先輩のことを考えてると、<CR>勉強に手がつかなくなっちゃうことがよくあるし……
records.en_original: Ah, that's true. When I think of the guy I like, I can hardly even study sometimes...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, that's true. When I think of the guy I like, I can hardly even study sometimes.
records.en: Oh, that may be true. When I think about my Senpai,<CR>I often can't concentrate on studying...

records.jp: なるほど……その気持ちならばわかる気がするな。<CR>研究に没頭していると、食事の時間も惜しい――
records.en_original: Interesting... I believe I know that feeling. When immersed in my research, I lament every moment I must waste eating...
records.en_auxiliary: Interesting. I believe I know that feeling. When immersed in my research, I lament every moment I must waste eating.
records.en: I see... I believe I understand that feeling.<CR>When absorbed in research, even time spent eating feels wasteful—

records.jp: そ、そこまでいくのはダメだよ！？<CR>ご飯はちゃんと食べよう、おいしいんだから！
records.en_original: Th-That's a little extreme! You need to eat! Food's too good to pass up!
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that's a little extreme! You need to eat! Food's too good to pass up!
records.en: Th-That's taking it too far!<CR>You've got to eat properly. Food is delicious!

records.jp: あ、あはは……。<CR>でも、ある意味似てるのかもね……
records.en_original: A-Ahaha... But I suppose that is similar, in a way...
records.en_auxiliary: A-ahaha... But I suppose that is similar, in a way...
records.en: A-Ahaha...<CR>But in a sense, maybe it's similar...

records.jp: ……そうだな。<CR>他のことに手がつかなくなるほどの気持ち……か
records.en_original: ...So it seems. Love is a feeling of not wanting to do anything else, is it?
records.en_auxiliary: ...So it seems. Love is a feeling of not wanting to do anything else, is it?
records.en: ...I see.<CR>A feeling so strong that you cannot attend to anything else...

records.jp: それが人に向くかどうかの違いと思えば、<CR>何となく理解できそうな気はする
records.en_original: Although it's not directed towards people in my case, I feel as though I understand somewhat.
records.en_auxiliary: Although it's not directed towards people in my case, I feel as though I understand somewhat.
records.en: If the only difference is whether that feeling is directed at a person,<CR>I feel I can understand it somewhat.

records.jp: うんうん。実際に恋をするようになったら、<CR>もっとはっきりしてくるんじゃないかな
records.en_original: Yeah. And once you actually fall in love, it all starts getting clearer.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. And once you actually fall in love, it all starts getting clearer.
records.en: Exactly. Once you actually fall in love,<CR>it will probably become clearer.

records.jp: そうしたら、その時はいくらでも<CR>恋の悩みを聞いちゃうよ！
records.en_original: When that time comes, I'll listen to your love troubles anytime!
records.en_auxiliary: When that time comes, I'll listen to your love troubles anytime!
records.en: And when that happens,<CR>I'll listen to all your worries about love!

records.jp: そ、そうか……すまない、<CR>その時はよろしく頼む……
records.en_original: I-I see... Thank you, I'll do that, if the time comes...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I see... Thank you, I'll do that if the time comes.
records.en: I-I see... Thank you.<CR>When the time comes, I shall rely on you...

records.jp: （ふふ……有理も一歩前進、かな……？）
records.en_original: (Hehe... I think this is a step forward for Yuri...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hehe. I think this is a step forward for Yuri.)
records.en: (Hehe... I think this is a step forward for Yuri...)

records.jp: きっとそれは――
records.en_original: The closest thing probably is...
records.en_auxiliary: The closest thing probably is...
records.en: Perhaps it would be—
